correctness.rationale: PASS: For P=product of k full-dimensional polygons, beta integration gives polar volume factor (2!)^k/(2k)! and complete flag interleaving gives F(P)=(2k)! product n_j, so R(P)=product (2 area(Q_j) area((Q_j-Q_j)^polar)/n_j). Triangle factor gives 1; a general quadrilateral normal form with p>=q>=1 yields M(Q)=2-[q(p-q)^2+(pq-1)^2]/[2pq(p+1)(q+1)], equality only parallelograms. Brunn-Minkowski and planar Santaló bound all n>=5 factors by pi²/10<1. Sharp Meyer-Reisner planar polygon result yields central-symmetric side-count bound n/2 sin²(pi/n), equality at affine-regular factors; this decreases for n>=4 and yields (3/4)^r when r nonquadrilateral symmetric factors are hexagons. Independent exact rational polar-halfplane polygon intersection calculations agreed with the nontrivial quadrilateral formula in five (p,q) pairs, not a proof of all polygons.
residual_risks: Classification only for products of planar polygons; arbitrary polytope equality is not resolved.
Uniform arbitrary-polygon n>=5 gap pi²/10 is not asserted optimal.
